googlePlay.title: FamCall: Simple Voice Calls
googlePlay.shortDescription: Simple voice calls, built with weak and unstable internet in mind.
googlePlay.verification: Console showed Your changes have been saved and Draft saved after Save as draft. All fields and 1/1 icon, 1/1 feature and 6/8 phone assets were visible.
googlePlay.apiLimitation: Publishing API requires automatic review for this app. Its edit was deleted without commit. Console draft is separate and is not exposed as a committed listing by Publishing API.

workflowNote: Apple upload completed and readback verified; Google API draft commit was rejected, so Play was saved with Console Save as draft instead. Follow-up workflow uses only Apple mutations.
